context: A three-panel interactive dashboard visualizing 500K synthetic events: a brushable daily timeline (area chart), a log-scaled value distribution histogram (48 bins, foreground/background overlay), and a latency sparkline comparing Falcon O(1) prefetch vs. naive O(N) scan across the last 50 brush updates.
first_impression: Clean and well-structured; the three views form a logical cause-effect chain rather than independent competing panels, keeping working memory load low.
what_works: The foreground/background bar overlay in the histogram (blue filtered bars over grey full-dataset bars) elegantly preserves context during brushing without adding visual complexity. The 4-color palette (blue, green, red, yellow) is well within perceptual limits and each hue is assigned a clear semantic role.
what_doesnt: The latency chart is completely empty on initial load with no brushing activity, rendering the bottom third of the dashboard as dead space that looks broken rather than instructional. The stat bar color-codes Prefetch in green and Naive in red but the latency legend uses the same colors in reverse reading order, requiring a small but unnecessary reconciliation effort.
